scope: From the user's natural-language market-development request and workspace context to ranked companies, editable cooperation paths, development strategy, outreach email, and private-memory learning from user edits.
principles: The original search channel is provenance only and never determines the final primary role or cooperation path.
Only current-run or freshness-validated evidence may affect scoring.
Unknown evidence is not negative evidence.
Product and use-case fit is evaluated against the best enabled Cudy product track and the candidate role's actual target customers.
User-confirmed knowledge has higher priority than ordinary retrieval, while shared knowledge and user/workspace memory remain isolated.
Cooperation paths, roles and evidence restrictions travel into development strategy and email generation.
User edits to paths and outreach are retained as private learning signals, not written into the shared knowledge base.

modelRouting.escalationOrFallback: KIMI_INTENT_MODEL or KIMI_MODEL; default kimi-k3 for materially complex planning
modelRouting.callPolicy: Light Kimi runs every turn; deterministic parsing is failure fallback only; harmless confidence/count formatting is normalized before schema validation

modelRouting.purpose: Local-database RAG query and memory embeddings
modelRouting.callPolicy: Required for vector retrieval; source documents remain in the local database

modelRouting.escalationOrFallback: Deterministic playbook with required role-family coverage
modelRouting.callPolicy: Cached standard playbook; light Kimi checks template fit; complex non-standard tasks use Kimi-k3 planning

modelRouting.purpose: Lightweight candidate existence, relevance and category gate
modelRouting.escalationOrFallback: Same-tier resilient provider fallback; unavailable batches are held for downstream evidence, never upgraded to Pro
modelRouting.callPolicy: Batches of up to 10 after direct lightweight homepage fetch; compact semantic signals only, with deterministic pass/hold/reject

modelRouting.purpose: Entity correction, atomic facts and primary-role analysis
modelRouting.escalationOrFallback: DEEPSEEK_ESCALATION_MODEL; default deepseek-v4-pro; deterministic fallback is retry-only
modelRouting.callPolicy: Routine batches; upgrade only for expected score change >=8 or a resolvable critical-state change

modelRouting.purpose: Role-aware score and possible cooperation paths
modelRouting.callPolicy: Routine batches; confidence, alternative paths and Top-N position never trigger upgrade alone

modelRouting.purpose: Blind secondary review and disagreement judgment
modelRouting.defaultModel: LEAD_REVIEW_MODEL default gpt-5.6-terra; LEAD_JUDGE_MODEL default gpt-5.6-sol
modelRouting.escalationOrFallback: DeepSeek review adapter using deepseek-v4-pro when explicitly routed
modelRouting.callPolicy: Selective only; skipped for the search-tool leaderboard where cooperation-path review cannot affect the metric
One call per generated email, plus one bounded retry only for invalid JSON/schema output

modelRouting.purpose: User-feedback revision and reusable private-memory extraction
modelRouting.escalationOrFallback: Keep the user draft and record a failed memory event
modelRouting.callPolicy: One call per requested revision; text-embedding-v4 embeds accepted private memory

stages.name: User request and editable business intent
inputs: Optional roles, products, constraints and nominated companies
outputs: Kimi requested/actual model, success state, usage availability and token/latency/retry usage
strategy: Preserve explicit user constraints
Treat requested roles as search intent, not final classification
Agent, Brand Owner and OEM/ODM are explicit-only; explicit English, Spanish or Chinese exclusions override keyword mentions
Never route OEM/ODM supplier sourcing
Mark nominated companies for deep research
Record the light Kimi call and any K3 escalation separately instead of attributing only the final model
Normalize non-critical objective and coverage-mode synonyms deterministically; unknown coverage mode uses the existing auto default
Normalize numeric strings, percentages and bounded descriptive confidence without replacing Kimi semantic intent; nonnumeric target counts fall back to the user-request parser
For frozen evaluations, require the recognized roles to stay inside the requested category, then execute the complete frozen role set
Preserve failed-call telemetry before deterministic fallback; formal evaluations reserve budget when provider usage is unavailable
stages.failure: Reject only structurally unusable requests; do not silently invent a target market or role, and do not discard paid-call telemetry when falling back.

stages.name: Workspace context, shared knowledge and private memory
strategy: Keep shared and private stores physically/logically separated
Give user-confirmed knowledge priority over ordinary retrieval
Never let private edits contaminate the shared Cudy knowledge base
stages.failure: Pre-search gate blocks lead discovery when required product, company or industry context is missing or uncorroborated.

stages.name: Market playbook and search plan
strategy: Use confirmed Cudy positioning and competitors
Do not average all product families
Keep original role lanes only as discovery coverage
Use the versioned active category route; the playbook supplies market language and product focus without duplicating provider planning
stages.failure: Use a deterministic playbook fallback with warnings when the model cannot return a valid plan.

stages.name: Multi-source candidate discovery
outputs: Per-call request, grounding-query, yield, cost, latency, retry and discard telemetry
strategy: Run the confirmed category-specific provider tracks with shared real-time deduplication
Use DeepSeek Flash only for a compact lightweight gate after direct homepage text; never upgrade this gate to Pro
Stop a track after two consecutive no-value batches or when the quality pool reaches its task-sized target
Tavily is forbidden in candidate discovery and remains evidence-only
Provider score and rank cannot enter final value scoring
Canonicalize domains and retain first, duplicate and assisted discovery provenance
stages.failure: A provider failure is isolated; same-tier route alternatives continue and are recorded. A gate-model failure holds candidates for evidence instead of inventing rejection or escalating capability.

stages.name: Fresh public evidence acquisition
inputs: Official-site and targeted public search queries
outputs: Tavily search/extract credits, attempts, retries and latency
strategy: Reuse current public-evidence-library material before spending search credits
Cold-start evaluation mode can explicitly disable both historical evidence reads and evidence-library writes while preserving fresh acquisition
Old-run evidence is discovery-only until reacquired or validated
Use Tavily only for targeted evidence discovery/extraction, not candidate discovery
Prefer official and independent public sources
Search for defining business actions, product tracks, target customers, size and cooperation signals
stages.failure: Failed retrieval becomes unknown; it never becomes a negative fact.

stages.name: Entity correction, atomic facts and primary-role decision
inputs: Submitted candidate identity and discovery roles
strategy: No upward-priority rule
Agent independently decides the primary business role
Distributor requires evidence of supplying downstream channel partners
A company may hold multiple supported roles
Non-standard model labels are normalized without discarding semantic role evidence
stages.failure: Ambiguity escalates to the high-capability model; deterministic fallback is retry-only and not externally publishable as a resolved identity.

stages.name: Research-depth routing
strategy: Deep research for global/national/valuable or nominated companies
Standard research for ordinary viable candidates
Limited research only for positively identified long-tail candidates
Sparse web presence alone does not prove small size
stages.failure: Long-tail candidates may be held after targeted searches fail; strategic companies must not be downgraded merely because their channel structure is complex.

stages.name: Claim-linked model evidence packet
strategy: Never remove evidence referenced by a finding
Remove stale/discovery-only material
Deduplicate unlinked context
Keep keyword windows for products, roles, customers, scale and procurement
stages.failure: If compaction cannot retain every cited evidence ID, stop rather than score with an incomplete fact ledger.

stages.name: Role-aware scoring and possible cooperation paths
outputs: At most two compact possible paths in normal product mode
Selected path in normal product mode
strategy: Product/use-case fit 50
Path/influence 15
Same-primary-role scale 15
Execution 10
Opportunity/risk 10
Use the best enabled product track
Use role-specific target-customer and scenario criteria
Normal product mode uses only the five-path taxonomy and computes path FitScore deterministically from 30/25/20/15/10 sub-scores
Search-quality evaluation mode uses a score-only schema: score procurement/influence from role evidence and emit no paths, strategy, email or contacts
Do not output path Confidence
Unknown is not zero
Path memory is guidance, not unsupported public fact
stages.failure: Unsupported evidence IDs and paths are removed; schema failures retry only the invalid candidate and reuse checkpoints.

stages.name: Selective blind review and disagreement judge
strategy: Review only severe deterministic conflicts and unresolved critical states
Do not review solely for low confidence, alternative paths, generic warnings or Top-N position
Do not spend high-capability review on non-actionable long-tail research holds
Judge only outcome-sensitive disagreement of at least 8 points or a critical state
stages.failure: Retain a valid primary assessment when review service fails unless a severe unresolved trigger makes publication unsafe.

stages.name: Ranking, recommendation and sales-account tier
strategy: Account tier does not alter score
KA is only for downstream candidates
Tier-1 distributors use Strategic/Priority/Standard/Long-tail Distributor
Scale is compared within the same primary role
stages.failure: Any tier-1 Distributor/VAD assigned KA fails the deterministic quality gate.

stages.name: Restricted handoff and persistence
strategy: Keep handoff within transport budget
Only supported facts may be used externally
Carry role and at most two possible paths to downstream agents
Anchor downstream execution to selectedPathId unless the user overrides it
stages.failure: Email generation is disabled when the handoff is not ready for external use; strategy may still be generated with unknowns.

stages.name: User presentation and cooperation-path override
strategy: Show the Agent recommendation but allow the user to change the cooperation path
Preserve who changed what and when
Do not rewrite public evidence when the user changes a commercial preference
stages.failure: Reject a selectedPathId that is not one of the candidate's generated paths.

stages.name: Development strategy generation
strategy: Evaluate all viable paths
Anchor to the selected path
Use different strategy for distributor, downstream channel, retail, operator and project/specification routes
Keep unsupported claims internal or explicitly unknown
stages.failure: Fallback strategy remains inside the same handoff fact boundary.

stages.name: Development email generation and validation
strategy: Use path-specific templates and CTA
Every target-company factual sentence must stay inside the allowed-fact boundary
Use approved style memory without copying unsupported company claims
stages.failure: Invented evidence IDs, missing required markers or use of do-not-claim facts rejects the draft and triggers bounded revision/fallback.

stages.name: User edits, feedback and long-term learning
strategy: Store only valuable reusable preferences
Scope memory to user/workspace
User-confirmed marketing phrasing may be reused as approved messaging but does not become public scoring evidence
Never write private memory into shared RAG
stages.failure: Memory extraction failure does not block saving the user's draft; it records a failed memory event for retry.
